meta.title: Efendiler Grup — Certified Cotton Sourcing from Mersin to the World
meta.description: Efendiler Grup is a Mersin-based supplier of cotton, fibers and yarn waste. 21 SKUs, 14+ countries, GOTS/OEKO-TEX certified, end-to-end traceability.

hero.subtitle: Certified cotton, fibers and waste supply. From Mersin to 14+ countries, with full transparency.

intro.lead: Efendiler Grup was founded in Mersin in 2021. Anchored in one of the Mediterranean's most strategic trading ports, we build global supply chains in cotton and its derivatives.
intro.body: With 21 product categories, 14+ destination markets, and internationally recognised certifications, we operate a network that stretches from the Turkic States to the Far East, and from the EU to the United States. Traceability on every bale. Transparency on every deal.

cat1.label: 01 — Cotton
cat1.title: Raw & Organic Cotton
cat1.desc: Raw, organic (GOTS), linter, combed waste and damaged lots — the categories that form the backbone of the global cotton market.

cat2.label: 02 — Cotton Waste
cat2.title: Cotton Waste
cat2.desc: Sweeper, blow-room, floor, fly and cleaned fly.

cat3.label: 03 — Yarn Waste
cat3.title: Yarn Waste
cat3.desc: Ring soft waste, sized, bleached hydrophilic, open-end.

cat4.label: 04 — Fibers & Other
cat4.title: Fibers & Recycling
cat4.desc: Viscose, polyester, denim and combed cuttings.

sustain.card1_d: Every bale is traceable from harvest to shipment.
sustain.card2_d: Full compliance with organic and hazardous-substance standards.
sustain.card3_d: Prepared today for Textile Exchange's 2027 mandatory standard.
